svg.title: Amazon Bedrock routing and fallback through a LiteLLM gateway
svg.desc: An application calls a self-hosted LiteLLM gateway, which assumes an IAM role with AWS STS and calls Amazon Bedrock. Primary: the EU inference profile for Claude Opus 5.5, entered from eu-west-1, serving from eu-north-1. Same-model routing: the global profile for Claude Opus 5.5, entered from eu-north-1, serving from ap-southeast-4, used only when the EU pool is exhausted. Model fallback: the EU profile for Claude Opus 5, entered from eu-west-1 and serving from eu-north-1, used only when Claude Opus 5.5 is exhausted on every route. Each entry Region writes model invocation logs, including inferenceRegion, to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, with CloudWatch alarms separating 429 from 503 errors.
svg.text: same-model routing, only when the EU pool is exhausted
model fallback, only when Claude Opus 5.5 is exhausted on every route
